description:
Use this when the user wants to know whether something RipClip is working on has finished: "is my import
        done", "are my clips ready", "did the edit render". Pass the job_id that import_video, find_clips, find_moments,
        clip_range, edit_clip, style_clip, add_to_clip or translate_captions returned. Returns status, progress and any
        error; when done it also says what was made: the project_id of an import, the clip_ids of a clip job or edit.
        Long videos take minutes: call again after a short wait.
        Not for: cancelling or changing a job (not possible from here) or reading a find_moments result (get_moments).
        Free and read only. Next: estimate_hu after an import; list_clips, explain_clips or preview_frame after clips
        or an edit.
name: job_status
title: Job status
